notes.title: A sale is here!
notes.notes:
Just wanted to say thanks to everyone that's played and left reviews. There is a sale on at the moment so showing your support and sharing this game with friends. I also saw a review that said they wished it let them know in the description that this game is part 1. This has been fixed.


That is all, thank you x

notes.title: Minor Fix
notes.notes:
Greetings Elven Warriors, 
Two major game breaking bugs were brought to my attention,


1) In Jilliwinks mountain, when completing the first area's puzzle, the second boulder wouldn't budge if you had placed it in the correct spot but needed to reset later down the line. This has been fixed. Don't panic if the boulder vanishes.

2) In the broken maze, the secret chest that spawns the Ogre Knight's Spirit wouldn't appear, this would cause the player to gain the rewards without having to fight. This has been fixed (Sucks, I know)



Now for the minor.
There was a typo error in the first encounter with Lunny, she says "Idol Threats" instead it needs to be "Idle Threats". This has been changed.

Aside from that, everything is as it should be. If your saves have been erased I deeply apologize. I have added an NPC at the South Save crystal next to the first town, this NPC will ask if you would like a boost to your save, to which you gain XP and Gold, this is my way of showing how sorry I am you have all had to deal with the oversights.


Happy fighting Zana's. I look forward to seeing what your Zanas will become.

- GvH Universe

notes.title: Fixed Issue with issued apology
notes.notes:
Greetings Elven Warriors. 



First of all I would like to personally apologize for any and all inconveniences you may have experienced during your playthrough of Second Chance. 

1) A major issue was brought to my attention of when crafting an error message would pop up stating that a sound effect is missing, this happened because the sound it's trying to find to play was included in the script and not within the game itself. This has been fixed.

2) Once again Warriors, I will apologize profusely but this does mean your saved data has been deleted, I truly wish that your experience this time around won't be as bad as the first time. 


I wish you all good luck and look forward to seeing what your Zanas become.
Fight on warriors
